svg.title: 4. Failover testing loop
svg.text: Stop conditions (any one halts the experiment)
What a passing run leaves behind
Proving the RTO: a monthly game day with AWS FIS, stop conditions and outside-in canaries
GA moves new flows to us-west-2
E1 App tier lost in one Region
E2 Regions cut off from each other
• payment success in the surviving Region < 97% for 2 minutes
• ledger write p99 > 400 ms for 3 minutes
• canary failure from 2 of 3 canary Regions at once
• a human presses stop: the on-call owns the big red button
• measured detection time and shift time, next to the target
• the FIS experiment report and CloudWatch dashboard snapshot
• runbook and Region switch plan updated with what surprised you
• a ticket for each manual step that could be automated
